summary: At a geometric Frobenius at w, the attached representation and the Hecke polynomial match (sphericalCompat_std); eigenvalue 1 of the normalised representation gives the root ν_w of S, and unitarity of the local representation (Satake parameters) gives the whole string ν_w q_w^i.

steps.claim: Take a geometric Frobenius s at the chosen place over w, and write f's local data: f is fixed by GL_n(𝒪_w) and S = heckePoly(q_w, |n|, t) with the Hecke eigenvalues t (hasHeckePolyAt_iff_localFormRep).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨s, b⟩, y, _, e, a⟩ := w.isPlaceOver_placeOver.exists_isFrob (AbsGal D),
    hasHeckePolyAt_iff_localFormRep.1 hS

steps.claim: S(ν_w) = 0: the Hecke polynomial at w kills the geometric Frobenius s⁻¹ on the attached representation (sphericalCompat_std), so every eigenvalue of x.galRep(s⁻¹) is a root of ιℓS; 1 is an eigenvalue of the normalised representation at s⁻¹ (h), i.e. chiOneInv O (s⁻¹)⁻¹ is an eigenvalue of x.galRep(s⁻¹), and by chiOneInv_spec this eigenvalue is ιℓ(ν_w). Then the string ν_w q_w^i, i < |n| − |r|, consists of roots (isRoot_string_of_norm, the local representation being unitary: isUnitary_localFormRep), since ‖ν_w‖²·q_w^{|n|−|r|} = q_w^{|n|} (frobValue, |r| < |n|).
steps.lean:
exact isRoot_string_of_norm isUnitary_localFormRep y h₀ e a (.of_map (by
    simpa [↓chiOneInv_spec w.isPlaceOver_placeOver hℓ 1, b] using
      isRoot_of_isRoot_charpoly (P := comp _ ((chiOneInv O s⁻¹).1⁻¹ • .X)) (by
    simpa [aeval_comp, Units.smul_def] using (((sphericalCompat_std w f.2 (x.isEigenform hf h₀)).2
    (x.attached_galRep hf h₀) hS.1 _ w.isPlaceOver_placeOver).2.2 _ _ hS s⁻¹ b).1
      (w.isPlaceOver_placeOver.valuation_natCast_eq_one_iff.2 hℓ)) (h s⁻¹))
    ιℓ.toRingHom.injective) (by simp [AutChar.frobValue, sq, ← mul_pow, ← pow_add, O.rank_lt.le])
